title: Smoothness at a regular point with separable algebraic residue field
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], f:X→Spec k locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and x a point. Suppose the stalk O_{X,x} is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme] and the canonical residue field κ(x) is separable algebraic over k [def-weil-residue-field, def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. There is an open neighbourhood U of x with U→Spec k smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. No closedness hypothesis on x is needed.

source.place: Tag 00TV, regular local separable-residue smoothness criterion, applied on an affine neighbourhood.

proof.text: Choose an affine neighbourhood V of x. Its coordinate algebra is finite type over k, and localization at the corresponding prime is the stalk. Transport regularity and the residue field along this localization isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0E38, proof of lemma-closed-subscheme-nodal-curve, split-node specialization.

proof.text: The residue-field isomorphism respects k by the germ-stalk-map and residue-field-map equations. Mathlib Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable gives formally smooth residue field. Apply the proved upstream Algebra.FormallySmooth.localization_of_isRegularLocalRing in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.RingTheory.Smooth.Local. This is the regular-local criterion of Stacks 00TV in the formally smooth residue-field formulation; no custom IsSeparableExtension is needed. Translate via formallySmooth_stalkMap_iff. The open smooth locus restricts to a smooth morphism, giving U.

lean.statement:
theorem regular_separable_residue_smooth
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (x : X)
    [IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
    (hsep : @Algebra.IsSeparable k (X.residueField x) _ _
      (f.residueFieldAlgebraMap x).toAlgebra) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ Smooth (U.ι ≫ f)
